snippet.title: Nikkei Asia
snippet.description: Nikkei Asia brings insights from Asia, from the inside out. As part of Nikkei, Asia’s largest independent business media group, with over 140 years of history and a network of over 1,500 local and international reporters on the ground in 37 global bureaus, Nikkei Asia provides credible, comprehensive pan-Asian reporting. Designed for leaders around the world who are shaping the future of Asia, and anyone with an interest in knowing about the real Asia, Nikkei Asia has been created to change the way Asia is reported in the global marketplace. We report the facts about what is happening in Asia and offer insights over opinions that dig deeper into the heart of a story. Without editorial or political bias, Nikkei Asia tells untold stories about Asia, from Asia. You can find Nikkei Asia online.

snippet.title: BreakThrough News
snippet.description:
At BreakThrough News we tell the untold stories of resistance from poor and working-class communities. At present, five corporations dominate the media landscape, including 90% of what we read, watch, listen to, and depend on for information about the world. Nowhere among the headlines do we hear the perspectives of working people and movements for social justice. Our mission is to break through the static, disinformation and fluff.

BreakThrough / BT Media Inc. is a nonprofit media and educational organization dedicated to independent, fact-based reporting and commentary on a diverse range of issues affecting the global movements for social justice. We are a recognized 501(c)3 nonprofit organization in the United States. To remain free of bias and preserve our editorial independence, we accept no corporate donations or state funding. Our funding derives from our viewers and readers, and foundations that support our mission.

snippet.description:
Mediapart est un quotidien d’information générale, indépendant de tous les pouvoirs.

Depuis 2008, notre journal s’est fait connaître par ses informations exclusives qui en font un média sans équivalent dans la presse française. Investigation, politique, culture, société, international… Mediapart est un journal numérique d’information politique et générale, d’investigation, participatif et financé par ses abonnés, sans subventions ni publicité. 

Découvrez sur cette chaîne nos enquêtes et formats vidéos, nos émissions « À l'air libre », « La chronique de Waly Dia », « Les résumés d'audience du procès Sarkozy-Kadhafi », « L’Échappée » et « Abonnez-vous ».

snippet.title: San Antonio Report
snippet.description:
The San Antonio Report is San Antonio’s leading local online news source. As a reader-supported nonprofit newsroom, our coverage is never behind a paywall and we are able to publish without any obligation to outside owners or interests. We commit to earning the time and trust of our community by providing useful and informative news, insights and perspectives you won’t find anywhere else, always aiming to spur interest and action in San Antonio communities.

Since 2012, hundreds of thousands of readers in the Bexar County metro area have come to trust and depend on the San Antonio Report for credible, fact-based public service journalism.

Our reporters cover news about local government and politics, business and development, K-12 and higher education, community health, public safety and features on topics like San Antonio's culinary scene.

snippet.title: The Messenger
snippet.description:
The Messenger was founded to champion balanced journalism in an era of bias, subjectivity, and misinformation. The Messenger offers thorough, objective, non-partisan, and timely news coverage of politics, business, health, technology, international affairs, sports, travel, and more. We are committed to reporting the news fairly—not shaping it subjectively—and telling stories from all perspectives.

The Messenger launched in May 2023. It is owned by JAF Communications, Inc., a privately-owned American digital media company based in West Palm Beach with additional offices in New York and Washington, D.C.

Ergänzt wird das Angebot durch aktuelle Nachrichten, Interviews, Erklärvideos und Servicebeiträge zu Politik, Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Sport, Digital, Wissen, Gesundheit, Auto und Panorama.

Abonniere den Kanal und verpasse keine neuen Videos von FOCUS online.

snippet.title: Business Insider
snippet.description:
Business Insider is a global newsroom covering business, technology, and the economy. We help ambitious, curious people stay informed, understand the context, and get ahead.

Our videos break down how industries operate, how decisions get made, and how power and money move across the globe. We report on the companies, people, and trends shaping the world — and explain what it means for your work, money, and future. We publish videos weekly.

Expect explainers, deep dives, and original reporting on AI, markets, leadership, and innovation. Shows include Risky Business, Still Standing, Boot Camp, and So Expensive.

Topics include: business news, tech, AI, markets, finance, leadership, startups, and the global economy.

snippet.title: Tgcom24
snippet.description:
Tgcom24 è il quotidiano online del sistema multimediale all news di Mediaset per restare aggiornati sulle ultime notizie e sui principali fatti dall’Italia e dal mondo.

Cronaca, politica, esteri, economia, lifestyle, spettacolo e televisione: informazioni in tempo reale, analisi, inchieste e approfondimenti sui temi più rilevanti dell’attualità. Spazio anche a cultura, tecnologia, viaggi, salute e meteo.

Puoi seguire la Diretta di Tgcom24 su app e sito web tgcom24.it, al canale 51 del digitale terrestre e su sito e app di Mediaset Infinity.
